lhs: Accumulate widened products in U64 and clamp to U32 once.
rhs: Store each converted product and reduce with addition modulo 2^32.
conditions: Dense rank-three groups, one full spatial kernel, singleton spatial output. Parameter data constant over taps, optional reversal. Width 66052 and input/kernel value 255 in all three mixed profiles.
types: U8/U8, U8/U32, U32/U8 with U32 result under frozen evaluator profile.
overlap: Pointwise U8/U8 products fit U32; here the first excess comes solely from repeated addition. One symbolic witness covers all mixed orientations and both reversal flags.

lhs: Accumulate both products in F32, then narrow the final result to F16.
rhs: Store the products in F16, widen to F32 for reduction, then narrow to F16.
conditions: Length-two contraction on nonnegative integers through 63, with no free dimension, or a free dimension of extent two on just one operand. Default ALG_UNSET emitter, non-CPU policy where necessary.
types: Binary16 rounding-to-nearest-even; all F32 intermediate operations exact in this domain.
overlap: Small integer-valued witness specifically distinguishes the materialized half-precision products. Three graph shapes share the same failure.

lhs: Apply the same integer sum reducer to either leading axis, then to its surviving partner.
rhs: Lift the shortened axis, merge the two dimensions and sum one row-major fiber.
conditions: Arbitrary rank-three extents and third-axis outputs, including empty cases, same seed and reducer. Identity seed 0 guarantees equality. Generalized repeated-initializer correction is an additional mathematical result.
overlap: Historical zero-seeded grouped sums are reused conceptually. The new theorem checks the source axis adjustment and derives the excess for arbitrary seeds without counting nonidentity seeds as a source defect.
